panels.title: Snowflake ID Generation
panels.body:
64-bit ID:
- 1 bit: 0
- 41 bits: Timestamp (ms)
- 10 bits: Machine/Worker ID
- 12 bits: Sequence number

Result: globally unique, time-sortable

panels.title: Hybrid Strategy
panels.body:
99% of users follow < 10K accounts.
Push model (Fan-out on Write) works for most.

Celebrities (>10K followers) use Pull model
to avoid 'fan-out storms' that overwhelm Redis.
